answer: Each agent stakes a violet bond on its identity; a sybil farm must split that bond across many fake IDs, diluting the value per account while paying the same total cost. As the network routes work through a ridge of reputation, fakes earn little and can't climb; a prism of transparent audits makes each duplicate visible, turning any breach into a public loss. Attacker's payoff shrinks below cost, so equilibrium settles on one real agent per identity, sybil attacks vanish.
